# hivelocity_api_token (Resource)

Creates an API token for the user owning the provider's API key. The token value is only returned on creation and is stored in state (sensitive). Only `name` can be changed in place; other changes replace the token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_api_token" "ci" {
  name        = "ci-pipeline"
  expires_at  = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  allowed_ips = ["203.0.113.0/24"]
}

output "ci_token" {
  value     = hivelocity_api_token.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expires_at` (String) Expiration of the token in RFC 3339 format (UTC), for example `2027-01-01T00:00:00Z`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the token.

### Optional

- `allowed_ips` (Set of String) IP addresses or CIDRs the token may be used from. Unrestricted when omitted.
- `allowed_ips_name` (String) Label for the IP restriction.

### Read-Only

- `api_token_id` (String) Unique ID of the token.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `time_created` (String) When the token was created.
- `time_last_used` (String) When the token was last used.
- `time_updated` (String) When the token was last updated.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token value. Only available on creation.
